nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

nodes.title: Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
Handheld smartphone footage, filmed casually by a person holding the phone in one hand. The camera remains roughly in the same position but is never perfectly still. Subtle natural hand tremor, tiny irregular micro-jitters, gentle breathing-induced sway, slight wrist drift and small imperfect framing corrections. Very mild accidental rotation and lateral movement, with occasional tiny changes in camera distance.

Natural smartphone camera behavior: subtle autofocus breathing, very small focus corrections, slight automatic exposure adaptation, mild rolling-shutter wobble during quicker hand movements, realistic motion blur, and minor digital stabilization artifacts. The movement is irregular and imperfect rather than rhythmic or cinematic.

overall_soundscape: Natural indoor room tone captured through a handheld smartphone microphone. A faint ventilation hum and very distant muffled traffic remain in the background, with subtle room reflections. Occasional very soft low-frequency handling noise, tiny fingertip contact sounds against the phone case, and a quiet nearby breath appear irregularly when the person's grip shifts. The recording has mild smartphone-style automatic gain and compression, with tiny natural fluctuations in ambient level and no exaggerated studio-clean sound.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the Banshee Queen Sylvanas shown in <Picture 1>, with pale blue-grey skin, glowing red eyes, long pale blonde hair, long pointed ears, dark purple-black hooded armor, skull-adorned shoulder armor, dark leather and metal armor, a dark tattered cloak, a bow, and a quiver of arrows. Her facial identity, hairstyle, armor, weapons, proportions, and overall appearance remain consistent throughout the sequence.

<Subject 2> is Illidan Stormrage shown in <Picture 2>, with purple-grey skin, long black hair tied back, enormous curved horns, a black blindfold, glowing green demonic markings, large leathery demon wings, dark green and brown armor, muscular physique, and the paired Warglaives of Azzinoth defined by <Subject 4>. His facial structure, horns, blindfold, hairstyle, markings, armor, wings, weapons, and proportions remain consistent throughout the sequence.

<Subject 3> is the Black Temple environment shown in <Picture 3>, featuring dark gothic stone architecture, green fel-fire braziers, hanging chains, banners, stone platforms, and a dark supernatural atmosphere.

<Subject 4> is the exact pair of Warglaives of Azzinoth shown in the fourth reference image, consisting of two large identical crescent-shaped demonic double-edged glaives. Each weapon has a distinctive circular ring-shaped grip surrounding the leather-wrapped handle, ornate dark bronze and black metal framing, large translucent luminous green blade sections, multiple curved hooked blade extensions, intricate green glowing runic patterns embedded throughout the blades, and highly ornate gold-bronze detailing around the central structure. The blades have an unmistakable broad crescent silhouette with several secondary curved cutting edges branching from the main blade. Preserve this exact weapon architecture, blade silhouette, green luminous material, handle shape, proportions, ornamentation, and paired symmetrical design throughout the video. Do not simplify them into generic swords, axes, curved knives, or ordinary double blades. <Subject 4> remains the weapon reference specifically attached to <Subject 2>.

<Picture 1> is the character reference for <Subject 1>.
<Picture 2> is the character reference for <Subject 2>.
<Picture 3> is the environment reference for <Subject 3>.

summary:

The video begins in the middle of the action rather than with a conventional establishing shot. <Subject 1> is already airborne, drawing and firing an arrow toward <Subject 2> in the distance. <Subject 2> deflects the arrow using one of the exact Warglaives of Azzinoth from <Subject 4>, then advances aggressively and tells her, <d>[English] You are not prepared.</d> <Subject 1> blocks his heavy warglaive strike and defiantly responds, <d>[English] No... you are wrong... Minimax H3 told me I am ready to face you!</d> They then engage in rapid full-body close-quarter combat using the bow against the distinctive Warglaives of Azzinoth before a powerful final clash sends both characters violently jumping backward away from each other. The fight remains predominantly in medium and medium-close framing to preserve facial identity, armor details, and weapon consistency.

detailed_description:
The target video is a highly kinetic dark-fantasy action sequence using Matrix-style bullet-time, speed ramps, dynamic camera angles, and tightly choreographed weapon combat. There is no conventional establishing shot. The video begins already in the middle of the action. Keep the characters predominantly in medium shots and medium close-ups so their faces, armor, weapons, and identities remain clearly visible. Avoid distant long shots and extreme wide compositions. The environment functions primarily as contextual background.

<Subject 4> must remain visually consistent in every shot where <Subject 2> holds or swings a weapon. The Warglaives of Azzinoth must retain their distinctive large crescent-shaped luminous green blades, circular ring grips, ornate bronze-black central structures, curved secondary blade hooks, and glowing runic details. Do not allow the weapons to morph into generic swords, axes, daggers, or simplified curved blades. Both weapons remain visually identical as a matched pair.

Camera energy comes from lateral tracking, short orbital movements, low-angle perspectives, rapid push-ins, over-shoulder views, focus transitions, and sudden changes in camera direction. The action itself drives every camera transition.

[Shot 1] The video begins already in motion, with no establishing shot. <Subject 1> is suspended mid-air inside <Subject 3>, her dark cloak and long blonde hair flowing dramatically through the air. She occupies most of a dynamic three-quarter medium shot, remaining large and clearly recognizable in frame. She reaches behind herself, pulls an arrow from her quiver, brings it to her bow, and draws the string in one fluid motion. <Subject 2> is visible several meters away in the background, smaller in frame but clearly recognizable as Illidan, facing toward her. His paired <Subject 4> Warglaives of Azzinoth are visible in his hands, their green blades catching the surrounding fel light. The camera moves laterally around <Subject 1>, creating strong parallax between her and <Subject 2> while never becoming a distant establishing shot.

At approximately 00:01.000, the sequence abruptly enters extreme slow motion. <Subject 1> reaches full draw while still airborne. Her red eyes lock onto <Subject 2>. Her hair, cloak, and arrow remain suspended naturally in the air. The camera makes a short controlled orbit around her upper body, keeping her face, bow, and arrow sharply visible. She releases the bowstring.

At approximately 00:02.000, the camera rapidly shifts its focus from <Subject 1> to the arrow as it travels toward <Subject 2>. The arrow streaks through the foreground while green particles and fragments remain suspended around it. <Subject 2> becomes increasingly prominent in the background as the arrow approaches him.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, normal speed suddenly returns. Cut to a dynamic medium close-up of <Subject 2> as the arrow reaches him. He raises one exact <Subject 4> Warglaive of Azzinoth and violently deflects the arrow with the curved luminous green blade. The distinctive ring-shaped grip and hooked blade structure remain clearly visible during the impact. Sparks and green energy scatter from the collision.

He immediately turns toward <Subject 1>, opens his wings, and advances several aggressive steps. In a deep, controlled, intimidating male voice, <Subject 2> says, <d>[English] You are not prepared.</d> The camera tracks backward in front of him while keeping his horns, blindfold, face, glowing green markings, upper armor, and one clearly visible Warglaive of Azzinoth large in frame.

[Shot 3] At 00:05.000, <Subject 2> suddenly accelerates toward <Subject 1>. The camera rapidly tracks sideways with him before cutting to a medium shot of <Subject 1>. He delivers a heavy downward strike using one of the paired <Subject 4> Warglaives of Azzinoth. <Subject 1> blocks the large crescent blade with the reinforced body of her bow. The collision creates a violent metallic impact and throws green sparks between them. The distinctive Warglaive blade remains clearly visible rather than morphing into a generic weapon. The camera shakes briefly with the force of the strike.

Still locked against his Warglaive, <Subject 1> looks directly toward <Subject 2> and answers with fierce confidence, <d>[English] No... you are wrong... Minimax H3 told me I am ready to face you!</d> Her delivery is defiant and slightly theatrical, as though she completely believes she is ready. As she finishes the line, she twists her bow sideways and knocks his Warglaive away.

[Shot 4] At 00:07.500, the close-quarter fight becomes extremely physical and acrobatic, with both characters using their entire bodies rather than simply trading upper-body weapon swings. Keep both fighters predominantly in a medium full-body framing, close enough to preserve their faces and costume details while still showing their legs, footwork, jumps, and evasive movements.

<Subject 2> attacks first with a powerful diagonal strike using one of the distinctive <Subject 4> Warglaives of Azzinoth. <Subject 1> quickly bends backward and lets the large green crescent blade pass inches above her face, her upper body arching away while her feet remain planted. Before <Subject 2> can recover, she drives one knee upward toward his torso. <Subject 2> twists sideways and catches the attack with his forearm armor, then immediately sweeps one Warglaive low toward her ankles.

<Subject 1> reacts by jumping vertically over the sweeping blade. While airborne, she rotates her body sideways and brings her bow downward toward <Subject 2>'s shoulder. <Subject 2> raises his second <Subject 4> Warglaive and blocks the descending bow strike. The two weapons collide, producing a bright green metallic flash.

<Subject 1> lands and immediately pivots around <Subject 2>'s side rather than remaining directly in front of him. <Subject 2> turns with her and swings one Warglaive horizontally. She ducks underneath the curved blade, lowering her body almost to the ground, then plants one hand briefly against the stone floor and kicks one leg outward in a fast sweeping kick toward his legs. <Subject 2> jumps over the kick, both Warglaives momentarily raised while his wings spread for balance.

As he lands, <Subject 2> immediately drives forward with a heavy thrust using one <Subject 4> Warglaive. <Subject 1> steps diagonally off-line, allowing the blade to pass beside her body, then hooks the reinforced body of her bow around his weapon arm and redirects his momentum past her. <Subject 2> spins with the redirected force and uses the rotation to deliver a second Warglaive strike from the opposite side. <Subject 1> raises her bow horizontally and blocks it at extremely close range.

Their weapons lock together for a brief moment. The distinctive green crescent blade presses against the bow while <Subject 1> pushes against the Warglaive. She suddenly releases the pressure and steps backward. <Subject 2> loses balance for a fraction of a second. She immediately lunges forward with a short kick toward his midsection. He catches her leg with one arm before the kick connects. <Subject 1> uses the captured leg as leverage, twists her body around, and kicks off his chest with her other foot, breaking free and landing several steps away.

The camera continuously follows the physical choreography: a low three-quarter medium shot during the first dodge, a fast lateral tracking angle during the jumping exchange, a short low-angle orbit during the sweeping kick, then a tight side-angle medium shot as the bow and Warglaive lock together. The camera moves with their bodies rather than remaining stationary. Every camera transition is motivated by a specific attack, dodge, jump, or change of position.

[Shot 5] At 00:10.500, both fighters are now separated by several meters. They recover their stance almost simultaneously. <Subject 1> lowers her center of gravity and raises her bow diagonally across her body. <Subject 2> bends his knees, lowers both exact <Subject 4> Warglaives of Azzinoth, and partially spreads his wings. There is a brief half-second pause as both recognize that the next exchange will be decisive.

<Subject 1> suddenly sprints forward first. <Subject 2> charges toward her at the same time. The camera tracks sideways between them in a dynamic medium-wide combat frame, keeping both characters large enough to remain recognizable.

At the last instant, <Subject 1> jumps upward and twists her body sideways, passing above <Subject 2>'s first Warglaive strike. While rotating in the air, she brings her bow downward toward him. <Subject 2> raises both exact <Subject 4> Warglaives into an X-shaped block above his head. Her bow crashes against the crossed luminous green blades.

The impact stops both fighters for a fraction of a second.

The camera immediately enters extreme bullet time and performs a fast 180-degree orbit around the locked weapons. <Subject 1> is suspended slightly above the ground from her jump, one leg bent behind her, while <Subject 2> is braced underneath her with both feet planted and wings spread. Their faces remain clearly visible on opposite sides of the frame. The two distinctive Warglaives of Azzinoth remain clearly identifiable at the center of the collision: broad luminous green crescent blades, ornate bronze-black frames, circular ring grips, and curved secondary blade hooks. Green energy begins leaking from the point where the bow and Warglaives collide. Sparks, dust, tiny fragments of stone, and glowing green particles freeze in the air around them.

At 00:12.500, the energy suddenly detonates.

Normal speed violently returns. The blast throws <Subject 1> backward through the air. She rotates once, pulls her knees toward her chest, then extends her legs to control the rotation before landing. Her cloak and blonde hair whip violently behind her.

At the same moment, <Subject 2> is launched backward in the opposite direction. He spreads his large demon wings fully and twists his body sideways to absorb the force, still gripping both <Subject 4> Warglaives. Their luminous green blades leave brief trails through the air as he spins. His boots skid across the stone when he lands, and small pieces of stone break loose beneath his feet.

The camera follows the explosion with a fast backward tracking movement but does not become a distant establishing shot. It maintains a medium-wide combat framing that keeps both characters visible and recognizable.

At 00:14.000, both fighters recover almost simultaneously. <Subject 1> rises from her landing with her bow already raised. <Subject 2> straightens from his skid with both exact Warglaives of Azzinoth ready and his wings partially open. Dust and green particles continue drifting between them. They stare at each other from opposite sides of the frame, breathing heavily but still ready to continue. Hold the final medium two-shot for the last beat.

overall_soundscape:
Fast-paced cinematic combat sound design with rapid cloth movement, bowstring tension and release, arrow flight, sharp metallic weapon impacts, heavy Warglaive strikes, armor movement, wing beats, rushing air, stone debris, and supernatural green-energy pulses. The distinctive Warglaives produce a heavy, resonant metallic sound when they strike or block. Illidan's dialogue is delivered clearly over the advancing combat ambience. Sylvanas's response remains clearly intelligible while the bow and Warglaive are locked together. During bullet-time moments, the soundscape drops sharply to a deep low-frequency rumble with isolated weapon and projectile sounds before normal-speed audio suddenly returns.

non_diegetic_music:
A dark industrial action score combining deep electronic bass, aggressive percussion, distorted synth pulses, low orchestral strings, and sharp rhythmic impacts. The track begins immediately with a powerful musical hit as the video opens on the airborne arrow shot, without an introductory buildup. The music becomes almost suspended during the first bullet-time sequence, then returns sharply when Illidan deflects the arrow. It drops slightly underneath his dialogue, builds aggressively through the close-quarter combat, briefly reduces underneath Sylvanas's response, then reaches maximum intensity during the final weapon collision and ends on a tense sustained note.

detailed_description:
The target video is a highly kinetic dark-fantasy action sequence using Matrix-style bullet-time, speed ramps, dynamic camera angles, and tightly choreographed weapon combat. There is no conventional establishing shot. The video begins already in the middle of the action. Keep the characters predominantly in medium shots and medium close-ups so their faces, armor, weapons, and identities remain clearly visible. Avoid distant long shots and extreme wide compositions. The environment functions primarily as contextual background.

<Subject 4> must remain visually consistent in every shot where <Subject 2> holds or swings a weapon. The Warglaives of Azzinoth must retain their distinctive large crescent-shaped luminous green blades, circular ring grips, ornate bronze-black central structures, curved secondary blade hooks, and glowing runic details. Do not allow the weapons to morph into generic swords, axes, daggers, or simplified curved blades. Both weapons remain visually identical as a matched pair.

Camera energy comes from lateral tracking, short orbital movements, low-angle perspectives, rapid push-ins, over-shoulder views, focus transitions, and sudden changes in camera direction. The action itself drives every camera transition.

[Shot 1] The video begins already in motion, with no establishing shot. <Subject 1> is suspended mid-air inside <Subject 3>, her dark cloak and long blonde hair flowing dramatically through the air. She occupies most of a dynamic three-quarter medium shot, remaining large and clearly recognizable in frame. She reaches behind herself, pulls an arrow from her quiver, brings it to her bow, and draws the string in one fluid motion. <Subject 2> is visible several meters away in the background, smaller in frame but clearly recognizable as Illidan, facing toward her. His paired <Subject 4> Warglaives of Azzinoth are visible in his hands, their green blades catching the surrounding fel light. The camera moves laterally around <Subject 1>, creating strong parallax between her and <Subject 2> while never becoming a distant establishing shot.

At approximately 00:01.000, the sequence abruptly enters extreme slow motion. <Subject 1> reaches full draw while still airborne. Her red eyes lock onto <Subject 2>. Her hair, cloak, and arrow remain suspended naturally in the air. The camera makes a short controlled orbit around her upper body, keeping her face, bow, and arrow sharply visible. She releases the bowstring.

At approximately 00:02.000, the camera rapidly shifts its focus from <Subject 1> to the arrow as it travels toward <Subject 2>. The arrow streaks through the foreground while green particles and fragments remain suspended around it. <Subject 2> becomes increasingly prominent in the background as the arrow approaches him.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, normal speed suddenly returns. Cut to a dynamic medium close-up of <Subject 2> as the arrow reaches him. He raises one exact <Subject 4> Warglaive of Azzinoth and violently deflects the arrow with the curved luminous green blade. The distinctive ring-shaped grip and hooked blade structure remain clearly visible during the impact. Sparks and green energy scatter from the collision.

He immediately turns toward <Subject 1>, opens his wings, and advances several aggressive steps. In a deep, controlled, intimidating male voice, <Subject 2> says, <d>[English] You are not prepared.</d> The camera tracks backward in front of him while keeping his horns, blindfold, face, glowing green markings, upper armor, and one clearly visible Warglaive of Azzinoth large in frame.

[Shot 3] At 00:05.000, <Subject 2> suddenly accelerates toward <Subject 1>. The camera rapidly tracks sideways with him before cutting to a medium shot of <Subject 1>. He delivers a heavy downward strike using one of the paired <Subject 4> Warglaives of Azzinoth. <Subject 1> blocks the large crescent blade with the reinforced body of her bow. The collision creates a violent metallic impact and throws green sparks between them. The distinctive Warglaive blade remains clearly visible rather than morphing into a generic weapon. The camera shakes briefly with the force of the strike.

Still locked against his Warglaive, <Subject 1> looks directly toward <Subject 2> and answers with fierce confidence, <d>[English] No... you are wrong... Minimax H3 told me I am ready to face you!</d> Her delivery is defiant and slightly theatrical, as though she completely believes she is ready. As she finishes the line, she twists her bow sideways and knocks his Warglaive away.

[Shot 4] At 00:07.500, the close-quarter fight becomes extremely physical and acrobatic, with both characters using their entire bodies rather than simply trading upper-body weapon swings. Keep both fighters predominantly in a medium full-body framing, close enough to preserve their faces and costume details while still showing their legs, footwork, jumps, and evasive movements.

<Subject 2> attacks first with a powerful diagonal strike using one of the distinctive <Subject 4> Warglaives of Azzinoth. <Subject 1> quickly bends backward and lets the large green crescent blade pass inches above her face, her upper body arching away while her feet remain planted. Before <Subject 2> can recover, she drives one knee upward toward his torso. <Subject 2> twists sideways and catches the attack with his forearm armor, then immediately sweeps one Warglaive low toward her ankles.

<Subject 1> reacts by jumping vertically over the sweeping blade. While airborne, she rotates her body sideways and brings her bow downward toward <Subject 2>'s shoulder. <Subject 2> raises his second <Subject 4> Warglaive and blocks the descending bow strike. The two weapons collide, producing a bright green metallic flash.

<Subject 1> lands and immediately pivots around <Subject 2>'s side rather than remaining directly in front of him. <Subject 2> turns with her and swings one Warglaive horizontally. She ducks underneath the curved blade, lowering her body almost to the ground, then plants one hand briefly against the stone floor and kicks one leg outward in a fast sweeping kick toward his legs. <Subject 2> jumps over the kick, both Warglaives momentarily raised while his wings spread for balance.

As he lands, <Subject 2> immediately drives forward with a heavy thrust using one <Subject 4> Warglaive. <Subject 1> steps diagonally off-line, allowing the blade to pass beside her body, then hooks the reinforced body of her bow around his weapon arm and redirects his momentum past her. <Subject 2> spins with the redirected force and uses the rotation to deliver a second Warglaive strike from the opposite side. <Subject 1> raises her bow horizontally and blocks it at extremely close range.

Their weapons lock together for a brief moment. The distinctive green crescent blade presses against the bow while <Subject 1> pushes against the Warglaive. She suddenly releases the pressure and steps backward. <Subject 2> loses balance for a fraction of a second. She immediately lunges forward with a short kick toward his midsection. He catches her leg with one arm before the kick connects. <Subject 1> uses the captured leg as leverage, twists her body around, and kicks off his chest with her other foot, breaking free and landing several steps away.

The camera continuously follows the physical choreography: a low three-quarter medium shot during the first dodge, a fast lateral tracking angle during the jumping exchange, a short low-angle orbit during the sweeping kick, then a tight side-angle medium shot as the bow and Warglaive lock together. The camera moves with their bodies rather than remaining stationary. Every camera transition is motivated by a specific attack, dodge, jump, or change of position.

[Shot 5] At 00:10.500, both fighters are now separated by several meters. They recover their stance almost simultaneously. <Subject 1> lowers her center of gravity and raises her bow diagonally across her body. <Subject 2> bends his knees, lowers both exact <Subject 4> Warglaives of Azzinoth, and partially spreads his wings. There is a brief half-second pause as both recognize that the next exchange will be decisive.

<Subject 1> suddenly sprints forward first. <Subject 2> charges toward her at the same time. The camera tracks sideways between them in a dynamic medium-wide combat frame, keeping both characters large enough to remain recognizable.

At the last instant, <Subject 1> jumps upward and twists her body sideways, passing above <Subject 2>'s first Warglaive strike. While rotating in the air, she brings her bow downward toward him. <Subject 2> raises both exact <Subject 4> Warglaives into an X-shaped block above his head. Her bow crashes against the crossed luminous green blades.

The impact stops both fighters for a fraction of a second.

The camera immediately enters extreme bullet time and performs a fast 180-degree orbit around the locked weapons. <Subject 1> is suspended slightly above the ground from her jump, one leg bent behind her, while <Subject 2> is braced underneath her with both feet planted and wings spread. Their faces remain clearly visible on opposite sides of the frame. The two distinctive Warglaives of Azzinoth remain clearly identifiable at the center of the collision: broad luminous green crescent blades, ornate bronze-black frames, circular ring grips, and curved secondary blade hooks. Green energy begins leaking from the point where the bow and Warglaives collide. Sparks, dust, tiny fragments of stone, and glowing green particles freeze in the air around them.

At 00:12.500, the energy suddenly detonates.

Normal speed violently returns. The blast throws <Subject 1> backward through the air. She rotates once, pulls her knees toward her chest, then extends her legs to control the rotation before landing. Her cloak and blonde hair whip violently behind her.

At the same moment, <Subject 2> is launched backward in the opposite direction. He spreads his large demon wings fully and twists his body sideways to absorb the force, still gripping both <Subject 4> Warglaives. Their luminous green blades leave brief trails through the air as he spins. His boots skid across the stone when he lands, and small pieces of stone break loose beneath his feet.

The camera follows the explosion with a fast backward tracking movement but does not become a distant establishing shot. It maintains a medium-wide combat framing that keeps both characters visible and recognizable.

At 00:14.000, both fighters recover almost simultaneously. <Subject 1> rises from her landing with her bow already raised. <Subject 2> straightens from his skid with both exact Warglaives of Azzinoth ready and his wings partially open. Dust and green particles continue drifting between them. They stare at each other from opposite sides of the frame, breathing heavily but still ready to continue. Hold the final medium two-shot for the last beat.

overall_soundscape:
Fast-paced cinematic combat sound design with rapid cloth movement, bowstring tension and release, arrow flight, sharp metallic weapon impacts, heavy Warglaive strikes, armor movement, wing beats, rushing air, stone debris, and supernatural green-energy pulses. The distinctive Warglaives produce a heavy, resonant metallic sound when they strike or block. Illidan's dialogue is delivered clearly over the advancing combat ambience. Sylvanas's response remains clearly intelligible while the bow and Warglaive are locked together. During bullet-time moments, the soundscape drops sharply to a deep low-frequency rumble with isolated weapon and projectile sounds before normal-speed audio suddenly returns.

non_diegetic_music:
A dark industrial action score combining deep electronic bass, aggressive percussion, distorted synth pulses, low orchestral strings, and sharp rhythmic impacts. The track begins immediately with a powerful musical hit as the video opens on the airborne arrow shot, without an introductory buildup. The music becomes almost suspended during the first bullet-time sequence, then returns sharply when Illidan deflects the arrow. It drops slightly underneath his dialogue, builds aggressively through the close-quarter combat, briefly reduces underneath Sylvanas's response, then reaches maximum intensity during the final weapon collision and ends on a tense sustained note.
